nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What percentage of respondents agree that starting from recovered material would not alter the quality of products?
nodes.answer: Among the respondents, consistently 22 out of 30 agree that starting from recovered material would not alter the quality of products.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Closed-loop systems|Product take-back programs_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How do luxury brands and mass-market brands differ in their sustainability initiatives?
nodes.answer: Luxury brands often do not disclose the total quantities of items they annually produce, while some promote repair programs. In contrast, mass-market brands heavily promote take-back programs but do not always disclose what happens to the items collected through these programs.
